data.gender_notes: Ek is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ek is a Sanskrit name derived from the number 'one'. It is a unisex name that holds spiritual significance in Hinduism. In Hindu mythology, Ek is symbolic of unity, oneness, and the beginning of creation. The name Ek carries the meaning “The Number One” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit, from the number 'one' tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ek usually hope their child will grow to embody the number one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
